annotations.title: Praśna (horary): a question, a deal, or a horary number

description:
Use this when the user asks a specific question and wants it answered from the moment of asking rather than from a birth chart — "will this deal close?", "will I recover?", "will I find what I lost?" — or when an astrologer gives a horary number 1–249. Send where the user is as `place`; it is never defaulted.
The chart of the moment and place a question is asked, read on classical praśna rules, no model. Always: the praśna lagna and its lord, the Moon, the house of the matter asked about, the classical rules that apply (recovery from illness for a health question; recovery of a lost article when the question names one), and the further classical rules that held on this chart, each with its reference and the chart facts that made it hold. With `deal`: the deal praśna — significators (lagna lord = you, 7th = the other side, 10th = the undertaking, 11th = gain), their planetary contacts, the grounds for and against, and an ordered verdict (perfects, perfects after obstacles, contested, delayed, delayed and contested, not perfected); add `birthData` for the natal commitment calendar beside it, never blended with it. With `horaryNumber` (1–249): the horary table — house cusps for the moment that number rises, planets at the moment of judgment, their ruling lords, and the ruling planets; no judgment is asserted from it. Rules about caste, prenatal sex or death timing are withheld and counted.
Cost: 3 credits per call (only successful calls are charged; a sandbox key is free and returns a fixed sample).
Deterministic: the same input always gives the same answer.
Example arguments: {"place":{"latitude":28.6139,"longitude":77.209,"timezone":"Asia/Kolkata","label":"New Delhi"},"askedAt":"2026-10-14T10:30:00+05:30","question":"Will the supply contract with Northwind be signed?","deal":{"label":"Northwind supply contract","kind":"contract","signingDate":"2026-11-02"},"birthData":{"date":"1990-05-12","time":"14:35","timezone":"Asia/Kolkata","latitude":28.6139,"longitude":77.209},"horaryNumber":108}

askedAt.description: The instant the question was asked, ISO 8601 with Z or an offset. Default: now. Send this or askedAtLocal, not both.

askedAtLocal.description: The wall clock at the place when the question was asked, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm, read in place.timezone.

birthData.description: Only with `deal`, and with a birth time: the querent's natal commitment calendar is set beside the praśna for the signing date.

time.description: 24-hour HH:MM or HH:MM:SS, local to `timezone`. Omit if unknown: house-dependent detail is then reduced.

timezone.description: IANA timezone of the birthplace, e.g. Asia/Kolkata.

deal.description: Read the question as one deal (the deal praśna).

signingDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD, when it is to be signed, if not now. The natal cross-check reads this date.

domain.description: What the question is about: picks the house of the matter and scopes the classical rules. With a deal and no domain, the deal's own.

horaryNumber.description: A horary number (1–249): adds the horary table.

place.description: Where the question is asked. Required: a praśna cast at the wrong longitude is a different chart.

question.description: The question in the user's words. Gates the lost-article dictum; it does not choose the domain.

name: get_prashna

askedAt.description: The instant the chart was cast for (UTC).

deal.description: The deal praśna, when `deal` was sent: deal, lagna, moon (with its last and next planetary contacts and void of course), significators, contacts, grounds, verdict, natalCrossCheck (null without birthData), notEncoded, method.

kpHorary.description: The horary table, when `horaryNumber` was sent: {computed: true, data: {horaryNumber, cuspMomentIso, judgmentMomentIso, latitudeValidated, cusps, planets, rulingPlanets, notComputed}} or {computed: false, reason}.

bookRules.description: Further classical praśna rules that held on this chart.

withheld.description: Rules withheld on subject grounds (caste, prenatal sex, death timing).

quote.description: The classical line verbatim; null for a chart fact.

remaining_credits.description: Your one-time free credits left plus the paid balance, after this call.
